Mercury sextile the South Node can bring a saved note, former contact, half-finished idea, or piece of knowledge back at the right moment. Something you learned before may help you answer the email, solve the problem, or explain the situation with less effort now. Use what you already know. You do not have to reopen every old conversation just because one piece of it still has value.
